class.name: PhysXWaterSurface3D
class.brief_description: GPU ocean/water surface with waves, foam, shore effects, caustics, and height queries.
class.description: Renders a water body driven by FFT ocean waves plus interactive ripples. Buoyancy effects consume it through [PhysXBuoyancy3D]; spray and wake effects through [PhysXWaterSpray3D] and [PhysXWaterWake3D], both of which target it via their [code]water_surface_path[/code] NodePath properties. Query the surface with [method sample_height] and [method is_wet], and disturb it from gameplay with [method submit_impulse] or [method submit_sphere].

method.name: clear_sphere
method.description: Removes the interactive sphere previously registered with [method submit_sphere] under [param owner].

method.name: get_effective_fetch
method.description: Returns the fetch length actually used by the ocean spectrum (auto-estimated from [member wind_speed] when [member fetch] is [code]0.0[/code]).

method.name: is_wet
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param world_pos] lies inside the wet-sand band (recently washed by swash).

method.name: sample_height
method.description: Returns the displaced water height at [param world_pos] including waves and interactive ripples.

method.name: submit_impulse
method.description: Injects a one-shot radial disturbance at [param world_pos].

method.name: submit_sphere
method.description: Registers a persistent interactive sphere (a floating body pushing the water) owned by [param owner]; update it every frame and remove it with [method clear_sphere].
